source_screening.purpose: Screen concise source/build excerpts before using them as evidence in a static link-interface audit.
Screen the source excerpt that establishes generated-table and executable-link integration.

results.claim: Archive contains 4,746 distinct generated function definitions/references; 4,767 undefined names reduce to 21 external names (18 PS2Runtime, 3 Darwin ABI) after self-resolution.
All 18 remaining PS2Runtime methods are declared and defined in the pinned clone.
Build cache disabled runtime; saved compile/archive evidence does not prove linking.
Runtime CMake target requires raylib, default desktop FFmpeg, and ps2_iop; no dedicated headless target is present in inspected configuration.
Fallback syscall and import-stub paths remain semantic/runtime limitations rather than missing link symbols.
Registration table globals are present in the generated archive but current CMake does not link the generated artifact into the game runner.
Repeated helper symbol copies are weak definitions, not proof of a strong duplicate-definition error.

evidence_disposition: Bounded source and metadata checks only. Jev outputs are advisory evidence checks; the symbol-set comparison, exact source inspection, and CMake configuration are directly retained and qualify the conclusions.
